rows.en: Yamato: "Well, we're back..."
Touya: "Hmm? Who is it? It's open."
Derock: "Hmm. You really helped me out earlier.
I've come to thank you."
Touya: "Huh? Thank me?"
Derock: "Yes. I'll give you this special sticker.
It's yours."
Yamato: "Whoa. Derock's beaming from ear to ear..."
Derock: "An ultra-rare item, limited to 100 copies.
I'm making an exception just for you."
Touya: "...I-I'll pass. I wouldn't have any use for it."
Derock: "Hmm. I don't understand what you don't like about it.
But there's no point forcing it on you.
Well, then... Oh."
Yamato: "I've got a bad feeling..."
Derock: "I'll give you a lecture about the countries
of this world."
Touya: "You mean you'll explain them?"
Derock: "Exactly.
Now, which country do you want to hear about?"
Ask about the Kingdom of Agarthia.
Ask about another country.
Never mind.
Ask about the Zigrim Republic.
Ask about another country.
About that earlier...
Ask about York.
About that earlier...
That's enough.
Derock: "All right. If you want to know anything else,
you can ask me anything.
Well, I'll be going now..."
Yamato: "W-Wait! That's the washroom.
The exit's this way."
Derock: "...I know that.
This way is a shortcut. But I think I'll leave
the normal way after all. Well, goodbye."
Yamato: "...I wonder what the less normal way
would be...?"
Touya: "W-Who knows...?"
Derock: "Now, listen carefully.
As its name suggests, this country, which shares its name with the world,
originally ruled the whole world.
Its capital is Shangria.
Though it split apart several times, and the Dark Ages
broke its continuity, it boasts a history of 3000 years.
Even now, its territory covers roughly half the continent,
and it plays a leading role in this world.
It's a moderate constitutional monarchy, and because of its past,
the surrounding nations often take a somewhat critical
view of it.
It consists of 18 municipalities, and 12 of those cities have
the right to dissolve and elect the Agarthian Council.
They're known as the '12 elector cities.'
Within its borders is also a region called the 'Holy Land,'
which is treated as an independent territory.
Incidentally, the 'Holy Land' is the Alchemists' center of learning,
research, and workshops. Their headquarters.
It was originally founded to discourage the abuse of Alchemy,
and to promote 'cooperation for the sound development of technology.'
That was its purpose.
Free from the influence of any state,
it's an inviolable sanctuary where every nation is forbidden
to use armed force.
That's the end of the explanation."
Derock: "Now, listen carefully.
During a war 1800 years ago, it broke away from the Kingdom of Agarthia,
becoming an independent country.
Its strength and territory are second only to the Kingdom of Agarthia.
It was originally a monarchy, but a revolution 1050 years ago
changed it into a republic.
At that time, it faced pressure of all kinds from the Kingdom of Agarthia,
and it has fought the Kingdom of Agarthia many times since.
Its political acumen and intelligence services surpass those of the Kingdom of Agarthia.
In those areas, it has the advantage.
Its military has also modernized considerably,
earning a reputation for strength. With a mixture of contempt and fear,
it's called the 'Wild Valor of the West.'
The head of state is the president, currently a man named Nell Horem.
The president is elected by
popular vote, but the military is so powerful
that it wouldn't be an exaggeration to say General Growster holds
the real power.
That's the end of the explanation."
Derock: "Hmm. That's a good question.
It's said to have begun with a certain people who once built a settlement there.
The ancient name of the region became the country's
name. It's a matrilineal state, so naturally its head of state is a queen.
Unlike the Kingdom of Agarthia, it has a form of
absolute monarchy.
Its territory isn't very large, but its fertile land
and rich veins of valuable minerals have made it the target
of invasion many times. That's led it to build
a closed society. In York, there are also people who swear loyalty to the queen herself,
known as the 'Three Sword Knights.'
It wouldn't be an exaggeration to say they
protect the country.
It has advanced technology, and with a different technological lineage from the Holy Land's Armored Mechs,
and it builds its own Armored Mechs
with that technology.
Every nation recognizes the quality of York's Armored Mechs,
but there are few of them, and it has no force you could really call an army.
But there's a knight with the title 'Sword Radiance,' held by only three on the continent.
Garyud Via Vratzen. His presence is truly that of a
'guardian deity.' Ever since he began protecting the kingdom,
no country has openly sent an army against it.
A true elite few. Its defeat by Zigrim happened because
several misfortunes overlapped.
Queen Alforina was a fine person.
...That's the end of the explanation."
